title: Cambridge IELTS 14 Test 4 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: The plans below show a public park when it first opened in 1920 and the same park today.
scenario: The plans compare the layout of Grange Park in 1920 with its layout today.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

visualData.title: GRANGE PARK (1920); GRANGE PARK (today)
notes: 1920 plan: Arnold Avenue is along the north side and Eldon Street along the south side.
1920 plan: entrances are shown in the middle of the north and south boundaries.
1920 plan: rose gardens are in the north-west, north-east and south-west areas.
1920 plan: a stage for musicians is west of the central fountain.
1920 plan: a pond for water plants is in the north-east area and a glasshouse is in the south-east area.
1920 plan: seats are shown beside the north-west and south-west boundaries, near both central entrances, and beside the east boundary.
Today’s plan: Arnold Avenue is along the north side and Eldon Street along the south side.
Today’s plan: entrances remain in the middle of the north and south boundaries.
Today’s plan: one rose garden remains in the north-west, and another rose garden occupies the centre with seats on all four sides.
Today’s plan: an amphitheatre for concerts is on the west side.
Today’s plan: a café and children’s play area are in the north-east area.
Today’s plan: a water feature is in the south-east area.
Today’s plan: an entrance to an underground car park is shown at the south-east side.
